note: Predeclared BEFORE any candidate performance was inspected. Candidate ranges below are fixed for the entire one-factor sensitivity pass and must not be reshaped based on results (P7 spec Phase 3/6).
primary_timeframe_rationale: Positive P6 baseline, most balanced closed sample (70) of the three timeframes, moderate FAIL streak (5) -- avoids over-indexing on 30m's already-negative baseline or 5m's smallest sample when first probing sensitivity.

parameters.name: qualityThreshold
parameters.rationale: Named directly in P7 spec Phase 12 (Quality Gate Research).

parameters.name: minRR
parameters.rationale: Named directly in P7 spec Phase 13 (RR Gate Research).

parameters.name: overextendAtrMult
parameters.rationale: Named directly in P7 spec Phase 14 (Entry_Late/Overextension Research).

parameters.name: corrResolveConfirmBars
parameters.rationale: Named directly in P7 spec Phase 15 (Correction/Confirmation Research).

parameters.name: boMaxEntryLateBars
parameters.rationale: Named directly in P7 spec Phase 14; isolated to BO only, which has a non-trivial sample (unlike TC/PB).

sample_floor_rule.definition: A candidate is flagged INSUFFICIENT DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE if its closed-signal count on a given timeframe falls below 50% of that timeframe's P6 baseline closed count.
